# Spreadsheets That Do the Hard Part — Excel & Google Sheets

> Working Excel and Google Sheets workbooks for jobs where the arithmetic is easy to get wrong: WIP schedules, bid pricing, landed cost, SPC and more.

## Construction and contracting

- [Construction WIP schedule](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/construction-wip-schedule/): Percentage of completion with the loss rule most templates get wrong, plus fade analysis, income-statement tie-out and bonding ratios. $119, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/construction-wip-schedule-template
- [Electrical estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/electrical-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for electrical work, with a 40-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/electrical-estimating-template
- [HVAC estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/hvac-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for HVAC work, with a 39-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/hvac-estimating-template
- [Roofing estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/roofing-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for roofing work, with a 37-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/roofing-estimating-template
- [Concrete estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/concrete-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for concrete work, with a 38-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/concrete-estimating-template
- [Landscaping estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/landscaping-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for landscaping work, with a 40-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/landscaping-estimating-template
- [Progress billing and schedule of values](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/progress-billing-schedule-of-values/): Payment applications with retainage taken net of prior retainage, stored materials kept separate, and six checks before you submit. $89, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/progress-billing-schedule-of-values
- [Construction cash flow forecast](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/construction-cash-flow-forecast/): S-curve revenue, split collection lags, retainage release and a line of credit — to find the month you run out of money. $99, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/construction-cash-flow-forecast
- [Equipment cost per hour](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/equipment-cost-per-hour/): What each machine costs per hour owned versus rented, the break-even hours, and which machines you should not own at all. $89, 9 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/equipment-cost-per-hour-calculator
- [Certified payroll and Davis-Bacon fringe](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/certified-payroll-davis-bacon/): Annualises the fringe credit over total annual hours, not Davis-Bacon hours — the error that creates back-wage liability. $89, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/certified-payroll-davis-bacon-fringe-calculator

## Manufacturing and quality

- [SPC control charts and process capability](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/spc-control-chart-cpk-workbook/): Xbar-R, I-MR and p-charts with Western Electric rules, Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk, and a full AIAG Gage R&R study. $79, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/spc-control-chart-cpk-workbook
- [Design of experiments](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/design-of-experiments-excel/): A full 2^4 factorial with effects, ANOVA, a normal plot, Lenth's method and a curvature test from centre points. $69, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/design-of-experiments-excel
- [Monte Carlo simulation](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/monte-carlo-simulation-excel/): A working simulation engine in native formulas — 12 variables, 1,000 trials, five distributions and correlated inputs. No add-in. $69, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/monte-carlo-simulation-excel

## Grants and compliance

- [Federal grant budget and MTDC](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/federal-grant-budget-mtdc/): Builds the MTDC base properly — subaward cap per period not per year, equipment tested per unit, caps applied as margins. $89, 10 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets.
